Regulation: B.C. Reg. 125/2026
Made under: Attorney General Statutes Amendment Act
Published in: No. 14 – B.C. Regs. 125 to 148, July 28, 2026
Deposit date: July 17, 2026

B.C. Reg. 125/2026, deposited July 17, 2026, under theATTORNEY GENERAL STATUTES AMENDMENT ACT, 2025[section 23]. Order in Council 333/2026, approved and ordered July 17, 2026. On the recommendation of the undersigned, the Lieutenant Governor, by and with the advice and consent of the Executive Council, orders that sections 12 to 20 of theAttorney General Statutes Amendment Act, 2025, S.B.C. 2025, c. 16, are brought into force. — N. SHARMA,Attorney General and Deputy Premier; J. OSBORNE,Presiding Member of the Executive Council. minutes_briefs.title: BC Brings Sections 12–20 of the Attorney General Statutes Amendment Act, 2025 Into Force
minutes_briefs.summary: A BC regulation (B.C. Reg. 125/2026) has brought sections 12 to 20 of the Attorney General Statutes Amendment Act, 2025 into force. The change was made by Order in Council 333/2026, approved on July 17, 2026, and the regulation was published in the July 28, 2026 BC Regulations issue. The regulation does not describe what those sections say, so the specific rules that now apply are not stated in this document.
minutes_briefs.action_required: Ask your lawyer or legal advisor what sections 12 to 20 of the Attorney General Statutes Amendment Act, 2025 change and whether they affect your business.
